answer: A proof-of-space mechanism deters Sybil attacks by requiring agents to allocate verified physical storage. Participants anchor uncompressible data tables to an opal commitment scheme within a willow network mesh. An attacker must dedicate scarce non-volatile drive capacity per simulated identity, preventing free replication across a tundra of idle servers. However, adversaries with fast compute can regenerate challenge responses on the fly rather than persistently retaining storage.
